race.comment: HE'S MY WARRIOR (2) settled a little off the speed then picked up impressively to just miss the placings last start in a similar race here. Drawn to enjoy an economical run out of the inside stall. Gets his chance. ENNIROC (5) has savaged the line in recent runs. Got up late to score over 1030m at Grafton two back then came from next to last to be beaten under a length over 1115m at the same track last time. This sets up perfectly. DEMARCATE (4) ended a run of three top three finishes with a moderate effort over this trip at Warren recently. Not prepared to write him off on the back of one substandard performance. STRUFF (1) has found the line well in her two outings this prep, both at 1000m. Getting to this distance third-up is an ideal scenario. SAVOCA (8) is also ready to hit peak form at the third run back from a spell.
